sn35.164:1.3: yo kho koṭṭhika anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.5: cakkhuṃ kho koṭṭhika anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.6: rūpā anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.7: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.8: cakkhusamphasso anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.9: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo …pe…
sn35.164:1.10: jivhā anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo …pe…
sn35.164:1.11: mano anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.12: dhammā anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.15: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattā tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn35.164:1.16: yo kho koṭṭhika anattā tatra te chando pahātabboti.
